content: {"like":["Realistic action and special effects in gritty police dramas like Chicago P.D. and Season 6 of a cop series","Strong, character‑driven scripts in classic 1970s action series such as Kung Fu","Outstanding performances by iconic actors in period pieces, e.g., Daniel Day‑Lewis in Gangs of New York","Humorous and insightful outtakes in classic films like Being There","Well‑executed, emotionally engaging early scenes in Tarantino’s Django Unchained"],"dislike":["Simplified gunfights and lack of realistic combat detail in cop shows","Missing or altered original content and recuts in older animated series like Beavis & Butt‑Head","Inappropriate modern music choices in historical films such as Django Unchained","Poor script flow and focus in later seasons of serialized dramas like Mr. Robot","Inaccurate or sanitized depiction of historical settings, e.g., Five Points in Gangs of New York"]}
